_comment: This file decides which provider and which markets the card may
use, per league. It ships allowlisting NOTHING, and that is the
correct state until a market has been measured against real
prices and Cooper has reviewed the evidence and signed a human
acceptance receipt.
Entries are keyed `{provider}:{league}`. Approving a market in
the NFL never approves it in NCAAF.
Claude may prepare a change to this file and open a pull request
for it. Claude may never add a provider, add a market, or write a
receipt. See docs/provider_allowlist_approval.md.
PROPOSED 2026-09-25, NOT APPROVED. The entry below names every
wired market at Cooper's direction. It deliberately carries an
empty reviewer_name and an empty evidence_receipt_id, so
AllowlistEntry.is_allowed is False and market_allowed() returns
False for all 60. Nothing is allowlisted by this file today.
To approve: Cooper sets allowlist_status to 'allowed', puts his
name in reviewer_name, writes a receipt under
data/manual/human_acceptance_receipts/ and names it in
evidence_receipt_id. Claude did none of those four and may not.
allowed_provider_names is left empty for the same reason.

known_limitations: SCOPE OF THIS PROPOSAL. Cooper directed on 2026-09-25: "i want every market allowlisted. If it never produces a pick then so be it but i want it to try." This entry therefore names all 60 wired markets. It is NOT an approval: it carries no reviewer and no receipt id, so `is_allowed` is False and the card still selects nothing. Cooper sets the status, his name and a signed receipt, or he does not.

AGAINST THE EVIDENCE. The allowlist evidence bundle (data/outputs/nfl_allowlist_evidence.md) recommends enabling nothing: "0 of 18 markets clear every bar." 42 of the 60 markets here were never put to that bundle at all. Nothing below asserts an edge in any market.

WHAT 'IT TRIES' ACTUALLY MEANS TODAY. 30 of the 60 markets are player props, and select() refuses every PLAYER market while the verdict `props_selectable_when_undesignated` is unshipped. Allowlisting them changes nothing until that verdict ships. Separately, 31 of the 60 cannot be settled even if they were selected (see the per-market notes), so for those the forward ledger records `unsettleable` rather than a win or a loss — the live record this proposal exists to accumulate would not accumulate for them.

NO MARKET BELOW HAS BEEN PROBED SINCE 2026-08-28, AND `retained` STAYS UNPROBED WHERE NO PROBE RAN. A market recorded here as never fetched has never been fetched; that is a statement about this repository's archives, not a prediction about whether a book quotes it.
